name: Gilgamesh
source:
[spoiler]An arrogant, selfish, and enigmatic Archer-class Servant. He appears familiar with Fuyuki City and has an unrequited love for [url=/c33]Saber[/url].

Typically clad in ornate golden armor, he possesses countless prototypes of other heroes' Noble Phantasms inside his Gate of Babylon. Still, only two (besides Gate of Babylon itself) are truly representative of his true identity.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fate/stay_night_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
